message.reasoning_content:

That's "虚开增值税专用发票罪" (Crime of issuing false VAT special invoices) under Chinese criminal law, specifically "虚开增值税专用发票罪" (illegal issuance of false VAT invoices) which is a type of "税务犯罪". Also could be "骗取税款罪" (tax evasion by fraud). Under Chinese law, article 205 of Criminal Law: "虚开增值税专用发票罪" (for those who, without actual transaction, obtain or issue false VAT invoices to obtain tax benefits). So the appropriate charge is "虚开增值税专用发票罪". Also there is prior conviction, but new crime is this. So answer: single crime.

Thus output: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票罪<eoa>
